evaluation_scope: generated-family out-of-fold rows only; auxiliaries fit only

plan.decision_rule: Report fitting and out-of-fold late scores for every fold and all-phase/style results. Test whether phase separation solves fitting failure beyond equivalent shared capacity. Neither isolated late improvement nor pooled gains can establish final acceptance.
plan.epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
plan.evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
plan.loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
plan.purpose: Diagnose output suppression versus public representation using complete training games only. No candidate promotion or policy learning.
plan.scope: Training-only fitting diagnosis. Compare three independent phase margin heads of width16 with one shared width48 head, giving almost identical trainable margin parameter counts. Same causal public spatial/history inputs, sources, whole-family folds, minibatches, weighting, optimizer, epochs and seeds. Phase routing uses only public elapsed progress. No overtime override, no candidate promotion.
